Results.ReviewText:
In general this is a great grill.  However, I found that the recovery rate when you open the lid was slow.  Not sure if that has anything to do with the gas tanks I used or not.  Since I had a six pack, I didn't go out and purchase a different LP gas can to compare.  But I did modify the grill so I could use it with my camper.  Quick disconnect.  In addition to the convenience, the refresh rate jumped up to a very acceptable level.  I kept the original regulator and added a quick connect to it as well.  So now I can use the small gas cans for a picnic or non-camping event, or the camper gas when on the road.  Very nice grill!  I have already recommended to others.  

Other information:

Bought on sale at a lawn and garden store
Located on East Coast - last used (literally) at sea level but also used in the White Mountains
Would like it if they had a griddle option.  If there is one, I haven't seen it.  But would be really handy!

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are sorry to hear about the issue you are experiencing with you grill.It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. 
To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:



-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.



-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.



-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.



-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.



-Close the grill lid.



-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

If you continue to experience an issue after going through the following steps please contact our support team. Thanks!
